# LG case study assets

Source: user-owned LG portfolio design, Figma file lmP0Ar9RfHciiN22KNxClC, section 719:584, exported 2026-10-26.

- cover.webp is the existing approved cover. It is an illustrative device mockup, not a screenshot of the implemented tool.
- tv-context.webp is the exact rendered content of Figma image node 719:595, including its crop.
- tv-qcard.webp / tv-sports.webp / tv-control.webp come from image nodes 719:859 / 719:860 / 719:865.
- tv-factors-context.webp / tv-factors-browse.webp / tv-factors-control.webp come from image nodes 719:997 / 719:998 / 719:1015.
- tool-architecture.svg is the unmodified, text-outlined SVG export of node 719:1229 (1601 × 1149 including stroke bounds; original node canvas 1600 × 1147). Root dimensions and vector paths are retained.
- 01-input.webp through 08-settings-storage.webp are assembled from the exact source image strips already used in Figma (743:1908–743:1944). All 30 local strip SHA-1 hashes were matched to their Figma imageHash before assembly. Layout, screenshot contents and aspect ratios are preserved.
- previous-input.webp / previous-analysis.webp are assembled from the four matching Figma strips 772:249/250/254/255. These are the original final-report p.24 and p.26 tool screens.
- WebP derivatives are optimized for the web. No generative replacement or whole-case-study raster is used.
- No temporary asset URLs, report PDF, API credentials, or key-bearing report pages are included.
- User-supplied project images are used only to present this project. No independent rights to LG or third-party content shown within TV screenshots are claimed.

## Fonts

Locally hosted Noto Sans KR 400/700 (Korean and Latin subsets) and Inter 500/700 (Latin). Original font files and their OFL licenses are preserved in fonts/. Source: official Fontsource npm packages already used in the design-render workflow and @fontsource/inter 5.3.0.
